data.long_meaning: The name Analiese is a combination of two Greek names, Anna and Helena. Anna means 'grace' or 'favor,' while Helena means 'shining light.' Together, Analiese represents a graceful and illuminating woman. The name Analiese carries the meaning “Anna + Helena” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Analiese usually hope their child will grow to embody anna + helena and live with faith, good character and purpose.
